- Data Length (1 byte)
- Data Type (1 byte)

- Header (1 byte)

- Cyclic Command (1 byte)

- Length = 0x02
- Advertisement Type = 0x01
- Advertisement Flag = 0x06
- Data Length = 0x1B

- Header = 0x01
- Device Type = 0x1E

- Length = 0x02
- Advertisement Type = 0x01
- Advertisement Flag = 0x06
- Data Length = 0x1B

- Header = 0x01
- Device Type = TBD

Product shall use a high temperature threshold (referenced here as "HTT") for LBS state entry, defined as follows:

HTT = 65C

Product shall use temperature hysteresis (referenced here as "LBSTempHyst") for LBS state exit, defined as follows:

LBSTempHyst = 5 (where 5 is in units of C)

Product shall use voltage hysteresis (refereneced here as "LBSVHLHyst") for LBS state exit due to VHL measurement, defined as follows:

LBSVHLHyst = VHL x 5%

Product shall use voltage hysteresis (referenced here as "LBSVLLHyst") for LBS state exit due to VLL measurement, defined as follows:

LBSVLLHyst = VLL x 5%

Product shall use a voltage threshold (referenced here as "NBTH") to determine if a new battery has been installed defined as follows:

NBTH = TBD

Product shall use a threshold voltage (referenced here as "VHLThresh") for LBS entry/exit criteria defined as follows:

VHLThresh = TBD
Product shall support Battery Status Circuit that does not consume current when idle

Product shall use a threshold voltage (referenced here as "VLLThresh") for LBS entry/exit criteria defined as follows:

VLLThresh = TBD
Product shall support Low Battery Sleep (referenced here as "LBS") state such that in this state, product is shut down and functionality is limited to periodically checking for LBS exit condition.
Product shall reset whenever it exits LBS state.

Product shall enter LBS state due to crash count if the following crash count condition is met:

crash count > 3

Product shall enter LBS state due to temperature if the following temperature measurement condition is met:

Temp < LTT

Product shall enter LBS state due to temperature if the following temperature measurement condition is met:

Temp > HTT

Product shall enter LBS state due to battery voltage only if the following LBI measurement condition is met:

4, consecutive LBI measurements of VHL <= VHLThresh

NOTE: First VHL <= VHLThresh transitions to fast LBI mesurement. Remaining three consecutive measurements of VHL <= VHLThresh occur over a 30 minute period. (3 x 10 minutes).

When product is in LBS state, product shall continuously check for button press.

NOTE: any button press exits LBS state.
When product is in LBS state, if product enters LBS state due to temperature, then while in LBS state, product shall measure temperture every 5 minutes.

If product enters LBS state due to temperature, then product shall exit LBS state only after the following LBS exit condition is met:

LTT + LBSTempHyst <= Temp <= HTT - LBSTempHyst

NOTE: Temp is the temperature measured every 5 minutes in LBS state.
Product shall support Low Battery Sleep (LBS) mode to prevent memory corruption or other adverse affects from depleted battery.

When product is in LBS state, if product enters LBS state due to battery voltage, then while in LBS state, product shall measure VLL every 5 minutes.

NOTE: VHL is only measured if VLL is above VLLThresh + LBSVLLHyst

When product is in LBS state, if product enters LBS state due to battery voltage, product shall exit LBS state only after the following LBS exit conditions are met:

VLL > VLLThresh + LBSVLLHyst
VHL > VHLThresh + LBSVHLHyst

Product shall detect a new battery only after the following new battery conditions are met:

Product in LBS state
VHL > NBTH

Product shall transition from normal LBI measurement operation (1x per hour) to fast LBI measurement (1x per 10 minutes) only after the following fast LBI measurement condition is met:

VHL <= VHLThresh

Product shall transition from fast LBI mesurement (1x per 10 minutes) to normal LBI measurement (1x per hour) only after the following conditions are met:

Product in fast LBI measurement state prior to; but not yet in LBS state.
VHL > VHLThresh + LBSVHLHyst

LBS_ENTRY_FLAG_VHL : enter (or remain in) LBS state due to VHL measurement

LBS_ENTRY_FLAG_HIGH_TEMP : enter (or remain in) LBS state due to temperature measurement out of range high
